# logfire_gateway_spending_limits (Resource)

Manages the AI Gateway spending limits of the organization. An organization limit caps the Gateway spend of every project and credential in the organization. Requires Growth, Enterprise Cloud, or self-hosted and a token with organization:read_gateway and organization:write_gateway scopes (organization:read and organization:write are also accepted). Declare at most one of this resource for each organization. The resource manages all three windows. Destroying it removes every organization limit. Import accepts `organization`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap the Gateway spend of the whole organization. A window you omit has no limit.
resource "logfire_gateway_spending_limits" "this" {
  daily_usd   = 500
  monthly_usd = 10000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `daily_usd` (Number) The daily limit in whole US dollars. A day starts at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no daily limit.
- `monthly_usd` (Number) The monthly limit in whole US dollars. A month starts on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no monthly limit.
- `weekly_usd` (Number) The weekly limit in whole US dollars. A week starts on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no weekly limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `organization`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization has one set of spending limits, so the import ID is always "organization".
terraform import 'logfire_gateway_spending_limits.this' "organization"
```
